text: Confess ye to Jehovah, for he is good: for his mercy is forever.
Confess to the God of gods: for his mercy is forever.
Confess to the Lord of lords: for his mercy is forever.
To him alone making great wonders: for his mercy is forever.
To him making the heavens in understanding: for his mercy is forever.
To him spreading the earth upon the sea: for his mercy is forever.
To him making great lights: for his mercy is forever.
The sun for the rulings in the day: for his mercy is forever.
The moon and the stars for rulings in the night: for his mercy is forever.
To him striking Egypt in their first-born: for his mercy is forever.
And he will bring forth Israel from the midst of them: for his mercy is forever.
With a hand of strength, and with an arm stretched out: for his mercy is forever.
To him dividing the sea of sedge into parts: for his mercy is forever.
And he caused Israel to pass through in its midst: for his mercy is forever.
And he shook off Pharaoh and his strength into the sea of sedge: for his mercy is forever.
To him causing his people to go into the desert: for his mercy is forever.
To him striking great kings: for his mercy is forever.
And he will slay mighty kings: for his mercy is forever.
To Sihon, king of the Amorites: for his mercy is forever.
To Og, king of Bashan: for his mercy is forever.
And he gave their land for an inheritance: for his mercy is forever,
An inheritance to Israel his servant: for his mercy is forever.
He remembered for us our lowness: for his mercy is forever:
And he will redeem us from our enemies: for his mercy is forever.
He gave bread to all flesh: for his mercy is forever.
Confess ye to the God of the heavens: for his mercy is forever.
